title: Understanding Role-Based Access Control for the ZPA API

blocks.text: Role-based access control (RBAC) for all ZPA API operations ensures that access to API endpoints is restricted or granted based on user roles and permissions.
RBAC for ZPA API provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Enhance security and operational efficiency by ensuring that users only have access to the resources and actions necessary for their specific roles.
Reduce the risk of unauthorized access and potential security breaches.

blocks.text: To enforce RBAC for the ZPA API:

blocks.item: Create a predefined or custom role.
